Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today's demo

Hi Sophie — great talking earlier. Quick recap + concrete pilot proposal below. I've attached the prompt set and a small benchmark pack for the baseline tests.

Summary of asks we heard
- Hallucination risk on regulatory/product spec content (high priority)
- Dataset will be mixed (PDFs + HTML) — good to know for extractor choices
- Baseline metrics should focus on grounding precision and retrieval recall

Recommended pilot config (short)
- Candidate models: Llama-2-13B (float16) for highest factuality baseline; Redwood-Delta-7B-quant for a lower-cost comparison.
- Embeddings: text-embedding-3-small (semantic + cosine) — used for vector store and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN).
- Retriever settings: 800-token chunking (source-level chunk overlap 64 tokens), top_k = 10 retrieval, use hybrid scoring (BM25 warm-start + ANN rerank).
- Reranker: cross-encoder reranker v2 (fine-tuned on Q/A pairs) to prioritize grounding precision. If latency is a concern, we can swap to a lightweight bi-encoder + delayed cross-encoder for re-ranking.
- Prompting: enclosed CSV contains 18 targeted prompt templates (safety, spec extraction, user-facing answering). We'll run canned prompts in the bench.

Grounding & evaluation metrics (what we'll measure)
- Grounding Precision@1/3: ratio of answers with a directly cited source passing a human-label check.
- Top-k Retrieval Recall: fraction of gold-source documents present in top_k.
- Hallucination Rate: human-annotated false assertions per 100 responses.
- Latency 95p + cost/token: to understand tradeoffs for the cross-encoder path.

Deliverables & timeline (mutual action plan)
- Week 0 (this week): data onboarding checklist + secure upload link (we'll provide S3 presigned + ingestion guide).
- Week 1: index build + run baseline bench on 1k curated queries (we provide evaluation harness).
- Week 2: run cross-encoder re-ranking experiments + prompt tuning; deliver draft report.
- Week 3: produce final pilot report with recommended model, reranker config, and cost/latency tradeoffs; review call.

Attachments included: cobalt_pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv, cobalt_eval_benchmarks_080426.zip, retrieval_config_map.yaml

Notes/risks
- If HQ requires on-prem processing, timeline shifts by ~1 extra week for network/KMS setup.
- For regulatory content we recommend a stricter reranker threshold and conservative citation policy (cite-only-if-exact-match).

Next steps
1) Sophie: confirm data volume and whether any docs are air-gapped / cannot be uploaded to S3.
2) Naomi/Ben: share S3 presigned upload + ingestion checklist once Sophie confirms.
3) Schedule a 30-min intake call for Wednesday if that works for your engineers.

Best,

Looping in a couple operational items from the Dedicated/Hosting side so Sophie has the right expectations:

- Data handling: our ingestion supports PDFs, HTML, and plaintext. For PDFs we use an OCR fallback; please flag scanned images with low OCR confidence.
- Retention & security: default pilot retention is 90 days; if you need longer retention or KMS/HSM-managed keys, notify us now (may change timeline).
- Cost estimate (rough): baseline run for 1k eval queries across two model variants + cross-encoder rerank ~ $1.8k (compute + storage + embeddings). Full 60k-page index build will add an up-front indexing cost (depends on pages/avg tokens) — we'll provide a formal quote once we see a sample.

Naomi — I added the S3 bucket name and a temporary service account in the shared Drive link. Sophie — if you can confirm who will own uploads (dev or security), we'll create creds and an intake ticket.
